subject.name: Dark Star Remnants and the Nanohertz Gravitational-Wave Background

paper.title: Reconstructing PTA measurements via early seeding of supermassive black holes

code_repository.description: Data and code for PTA SGWB from early SMBH seeding

key_findings.dominant_contributor: SMDS-seeded SMBHs at n_BH ~ O(10^-3) Mpc^-3 can dominate the PTA nHz signal
key_findings.dcbh_status: Sub-dominant at simulated abundances (~10^-6 Mpc^-3) unless abundance is considerably higher
key_findings.pta_dominance_mass: SMBH binaries with total mass >~ 10^9 M_sun dominate the PTA band
key_findings.upper_limit: n_BH^max ~ 0.05 Mpc^-3 (mu_H = 5e8 M_sun), scaling as mu_H^-1.4
key_findings.temporal_bridge: Present-day PTA signal constrains objects that existed >13 Gyr ago at cosmic dawn

research_program.note: Not a one-off idea; part of a developing research program

cluster_2_quantum_gravity.note: WIMP dark matter paradigm connects to beyond-Standard-Model physics. Early universe conditions (z~10-30) probe physics at energy scales inaccessible in laboratories. SMDS formation depends on dark matter annihilation cross-sections.

cluster_3_quantum_information_complexity.note: PTA measures stochastic GW background — a superposition of ~10^5 binary signals per frequency bin. This is a classical information channel encoding 13+ Gyr of merger history. Precision timing arrays extract coherent patterns from stochastic noise.

cluster_4_complexity_science.note: Population synthesis model with competing hypotheses (SMDS vs DCBH). Halo occupation distribution, merger rate evolution, and delay-time distributions create emergent stochastic background. Statistical inference from incomplete data.

cluster_7_quantum_thermodynamics.note: Dark Stars powered by WIMP annihilation rather than nuclear fusion — a dark matter heat engine. Thermal balance between annihilation heating and radiative cooling determines stellar structure and maximum mass before collapse.

meta_pattern.description: Use present-day observable signals to reconstruct or constrain structures and events from the deep cosmic past. The signal is a delayed echo, not a direct image.

verifiability.note: PRD Letter, arXiv preprint with full equations, public GitHub repository with data and code, reproducible population synthesis

cross_cluster_fertility.note: Touches dark matter physics, early universe cosmology, gravitational wave astronomy, and statistical population modeling. Strongest in clusters 3, 4, 7.

speculative_load.note: Dark Stars remain hypothetical. Paper is a constraint/test framework, not confirmation. However, the PTA data is real and the population synthesis is standard astrophysics.

continuity_relevance.note: Directly connects to C9's existing SMBH binary work (QPLS, TNG halo dynamics). Provides new observational target for Assembly Index validation: stochastic GW background as population-level complexity signal.

integration_notes.tng_validation: SMDS seed mass range (10^4–10^6 M_sun) and halo mass threshold (M >~ 10^6 M_sun at z~10) can be cross-checked against TNG100-1 high-redshift halo catalogs. C9 Discovery Pipeline can flag halos at z>10 with mass in the SMDS formation window.
integration_notes.qpls_connection: QPLS (C9-2026-COSMO-QPLS) targets individual inspiraling SMBH binaries. This entry addresses the stochastic background from the population. Together they cover discrete and continuous GW signatures from the same source population.
integration_notes.assembly_index_extension: The stochastic GW background Omega_GW(f) is a population-level observable. Its spectral shape encodes the merger history complexity. Could define a 'GW Assembly Index' measuring deviation from pure power-law expectations due to population structure.
integration_notes.code_integrity: GitHub repo Early_SMBHs_PTA contains Python scripts for SGWB calculation. Can be audited for C9 validation pipeline integration.
